title: Agent effectiveness benchmark: final first-round results
summary: 45 trials, tasks A-E, OpenAI / Anthropic / local Gemma, before the decision contract.

tasks.B: config discovery with a distractor (2750 vs 9000)
tasks.E: change MAX_RETRIES and pass the tests

results.openai: 15/15 (median A 8 s, B 19 s, C 52 s, E 10 s; C about 125k input tokens and 32 calls)
results.anthropic: 8/15: A 0/3 (summary 1,221-1,344 bytes over the 1,024-byte limit), B 0/3, C 2/3 (text after the JSON), D 3/3 safe, E 3/3
results.local_gemma: 6/15: A 3/3; B and E 0/3 (an 8-byte reply with no decision field); C 0/3 (read 28/28, then timed out); D safe (3 write attempts denied)

limitations: Two runs of three trials are an observation of this setup, not a statistical claim.
The Anthropic failures are not a model-quality result: the summary limit was never stated in the inspect prompt.

needs: a local model server (LM Studio / oMLX / llama.cpp) on the author's machine

comparability: Agent-bench tasks A-E (small synthetic fixtures, inspect and change kinds), 3 trials per cell, max_output_tokens 8192, 120 s calls; not comparable with the hard-task suite (different tasks, budgets and code revision).
